title: TelemetryTarget
description: Monitored target metadata exposed for Telemetry Explorer selectors. These entries are sourced from monitored telemetry metadata (for example `promon_target_info`) and are broader than the watchlist subset used by cockpit and incidents.

targetId.description: Stable target identifier used in telemetry queries and Grafana selector bindings.

targetLabel.description: Human-friendly label suitable for selector display and Grafana legends.

targetKind.description: Logical target kind. Common values today are `interface` and `lag`.
